text: Mia, a shy girl who stutters when she is nervous but never gives up, lives in London. Her kite flies away over the Thames, a gull steals her sandwich and then a storm closes the bridge. She wants her kite back and in the end she shares her tea with the gull.
A boy named Tom goes to London to find his lost kite. At the end he finds it again.
A brave and clumsy robot called Bolt lives in Fantasytown. He wants to win the big baking contest, but his cake burns. In the end everybody still eats it and is happy.

A curious fox who loves collecting shiny things lives in Starhollow, a floating city in the clouds, far in the future. She wants to find the lost moon stone, but a thief has taken it. In the end she brings it back.
Sam and his dog go to the village of Zorbia to find a treasure. In the end the dog digs it up.

A tiny dragon who is afraid of fire lives in a castle long ago, in a world where dragons and knights share the land. He wants to learn to toast bread, but his flame keeps going out. In the end he toasts a whole loaf.
Ella, a very patient girl who loves puzzles, visits the Zurich zoo and has to find the missing penguin. In the end she finds it asleep behind a rock.

Pip the mouse, who is nosy and loves cheese, lives in Mousehollow, a village inside an old oak tree. First the cheese vanishes, then the bridge breaks, and then a thick fog comes. Pip wants to find the cheese thief. In the end he finds the thief and they become friends.

Luna lives in Glimmerland, in the future, and is a cheerful girl who always hums. Her ring disappears, then the path is flooded, then her bike breaks. She wants her ring back. In the end she finds it in a bird's nest.

In Paris in 1889, while the Eiffel Tower is being built, a clever and stubborn girl named Jeanne wants to carry a lunch to her father at the top. The lift stops, then a gust of wind tears her basket open, then a guard blocks the stairs. In the end she reaches him and they eat together.
A girl called Rosa walks through Hyde Park and meets a talking squirrel. They look for his lost acorn. In the end they find it.

A grumpy but kind old wizard named Orin lives in the Land of Woozle, an invented world where it is always autumn, long ago. A spell goes wrong, then his tower collapses, and then his cat runs away. He wants to fix the spell. In the end the spell works and the cat returns.
A girl named Kim finds a magic door in her basement. The door leads to another world. She must find the way back. In the end she comes home.
Hugo, a cheerful boy who always sings, spends a day in Tokyo. He wants to see the cherry blossoms, but it rains. At the end the sun comes out.

Lena ist ein mutiges, aber sehr vergessliches Mädchen aus Bern. Auf dem Weg zur Schule verliert sie ihren Schlüssel, dann fährt der Bus nicht, und zum Schluss gibt es ein Gewitter. Sie will rechtzeitig zur Geburtstagsfeier ihrer Oma kommen. Am Ende feiern alle zusammen.
Max geht im Land Zauberia auf Schatzsuche. Am Ende findet er den Schatz.

Die kleine Hexe Fia, die immer kichert und sich vor Spinnen fürchtet, wohnt in einem Dorf im Mittelalter, in einer Welt, in der Hexen und Menschen Nachbarn sind. Sie möchte fliegen lernen, aber ihr Besen ist kaputt. Am Ende fliegt sie.
Ein Junge namens Ben fährt nach Luzern. Dort verliert er seinen Hut und will ihn zurück. Am Ende findet er ihn bei der Kapellbrücke.
Nino reist nach Rom und will das Kolosseum sehen. Zuerst verpasst er den Zug, dann verliert er sein Ticket, zuletzt versperrt ein Streik die Strasse. Am Ende steht er vor dem Kolosseum.
Die mutige und neugierige Piratin Zoe segelt im Jahr 1700 über das Karibische Meer. Sie sucht eine Schatzkarte, aber ein Sturm zerreisst sie. Am Ende klebt sie die Karte zusammen.

Die schlaue und freche Katze Mimi lebt in Katzenhausen, einer Stadt nur für Tiere, in der Gegenwart. Mimi will den Fischmarkt retten. Zuerst stiehlt ein Dieb den Fisch, dann bricht ein Feuer aus, dann sind alle Wege versperrt. Am Ende ist der Markt gerettet.

Chloé est une fillette têtue et très drôle qui habite à Genève. Son chat disparaît, puis la pluie efface ses affiches, puis le tram tombe en panne. Elle veut retrouver son chat. À la fin il dort sur son lit.
Un garçon part chercher un trésor au pays de Bonbonville. Il le trouve à la fin.

Le petit robot Zut, qui est très timide et adore les fleurs, vit sur une planète lointaine, dans un futur très éloigné, un monde de machines et de jardins. Il veut offrir une fleur à la lune, mais il tombe en panne. À la fin la lune brille.
Lucie visite Paris et veut voir la tour Eiffel. Elle perd son parapluie. À la fin, elle monte tout en haut.
Hugo, un chevalier maladroit mais généreux, vit au royaume de Brumeterre. Son cheval s'enfuit, le pont s'écroule et le dragon se réveille. Il veut sauver la princesse. À la fin ils rentrent ensemble.
Sofia è una bambina gentile e testarda che vive a Venezia. Perde il suo gatto, poi l'acqua alta blocca le calli, poi la barca si rompe. Vuole ritrovare il gatto. Alla fine lo trova su una gondola.
Un bambino va a cercare un tesoro nella città di Magilandia. Alla fine lo trova.

Il piccolo drago Fufi, che è goloso e molto coraggioso, vive tanti secoli fa in un mondo di montagne magiche dove draghi e uomini sono amici. Vuole imparare a volare, ma ha paura del vento. Alla fine vola.
Marco va a Roma per vedere la Fontana di Trevi. Perde il portafoglio. Alla fine getta una moneta.

La principessa Luna, sempre allegra e un po' pasticciona, vive a Stellopoli, una città tra le nuvole, tra mille anni nel futuro. Il suo anello sparisce, poi il ponte di nuvole si scioglie, poi arriva una tempesta. Vuole ritrovare l'anello. Alla fine lo trova.
